title: seqera-services/bifrost pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

test_substance.description: Name of the substance being tested

cell_type.description: Type of cells used in the experiment

counts.description: 2D array where each inner array contains counts for one probe across all samples

batch_index.description: Array of batch indices (1-based) for each sample

concentration.description: Array of concentrations for each sample

n_treatment_batch.description: Number of treatment batches in the dataset

total_count.description: Array of total counts for each sample (optional, calculated from counts if not provided)
